cases.sentence: Горе пастухам, которые губят и разгоняют овец моего ___.
cases.translation: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture.
cases.explain: The possessive construction овцы стада (sheep of the flock) requires genitive case.

cases.sentence: Это вы рассеяли мою отару, разогнали ее и не позаботились о ___.
cases.translation: You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not cared for them.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about, concerning) requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Они больше не будут знать ни страха, ни ___.
cases.translation: They will no longer be afraid or dismayed.
cases.explain: In the construction ни страха, ни трепета (neither fear nor dread), both nouns take genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он будет вершить в стране справедливость и ___.
cases.translation: He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.
cases.explain: The verb вершить (to execute, to accomplish) is transitive and requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Сердце во мне разрывается из-за Господа и Его святых ___.
cases.translation: My heart is broken because of the Lord and His holy words.
cases.explain: The preposition из-за (because of) requires the genitive case.

cases.translation: The pastures have dried up in the wilderness.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Кто стоял в совете Господнем, чтобы слышать Слово ___?
cases.translation: Who has stood in the council of Yahweh to hear His word?
cases.explain: The verb слышать (to hear) is transitive and requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Разве мое слово не подобно огню и молоту, что раскалывает ___?
cases.translation: Is not my word like fire and like a hammer that breaks the rock?
cases.explain: The verb раскалывает (breaks) is transitive and requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Горе пастухам, которые губят и разгоняют овец моего стада, возвещает Господь.
reading.question: Who is condemned in this pronouncement of woe?
options: Shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of the flock
reading.correct: Shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of the flock
reading.explain: The text begins: 'Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture.'

reading.ru: Я сам соберу уцелевших из моей отары со всех стран, куда я их изгнал, и верну их в их загоны, где они будут плодиться и размножаться.
reading.question: What does God promise to do for the remnant of His flock?
options: Gather them from all lands and bring them back to multiply
reading.correct: Gather them from all lands and bring them back to multiply
reading.explain: God says: 'I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries...and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.'

reading.ru: Непременно настанут дни, возвещает Господь. Когда я воздвигну для Давида праведную ветвь, царя, который будет править мудро и вершить в стране справедливость и правосудие.
reading.question: What does God promise for the line of David?
options: Raise a righteous Branch—a king who will rule wisely and execute justice
Establish lasting peace with all nations
reading.correct: Raise a righteous Branch—a king who will rule wisely and execute justice
reading.explain: The text states: 'I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he will reign as king and deal wisely.'

reading.ru: В самарийских пророках я вижу нечто отвратительное. Именем Баала они пророчествовали. Избили с пути народ мой Израиль.
reading.question: What is wrong with the prophets of Samaria?
options: They prophesied in the name of Baal and led Israel astray
They refused to speak against sin
reading.correct: They prophesied in the name of Baal and led Israel astray
reading.explain: The text says: 'In the prophets of Samaria I have seen folly. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.'

reading.ru: Они обнадеживают вас напрасно. Они говорят вам то, что им пригрезилось, а не то, что от уст Господних.
reading.question: What is the nature of the false prophets' deception?
options: They give false hope, speaking dreams rather than God's word
They speak truth mixed with lies
They predict too distant a future
reading.correct: They give false hope, speaking dreams rather than God's word
reading.explain: The text says: 'They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.'

reading.ru: Разве мое слово не подобно огню, возвещает Господь, и молоту, что раскалывает скалу?
reading.question: To what does God compare His word?
options: Fire and a hammer that breaks rock
reading.correct: Fire and a hammer that breaks rock
reading.explain: God asks: 'Isn't my word like fire and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?'
